changes.sourceChinese: 皝以段遼屢為邊患，遣將軍宋回稱籓于石季龍，請師討遼。
changes.before: Because Duan Liao repeatedly was a border trouble, sent general Song Hui to declare vassalage to Shi Jilong, requesting troops to strike Liao.
changes.after: Because Duan Liao repeatedly caused trouble on the frontier, Huang sent General Song Hui to declare vassalage to Shi Jilong and request troops to attack Liao.
changes.reason: The source explicitly makes Huang (皝) the subject, but the existing literal English has no subject before sent. Restore the explicit subject while preserving the general title, repeated frontier trouble, vassalage and troop request.

repeatedUseScan.current: Magistrate Liu Cheng of Juqiu, whom Ren had appointed, surrendered the city; a man of Xinchang, Zhang Heng, seized the county chief and surrendered.
Liu Cheng, whom Ren had installed at Juqiu, yielded the town, while Zhang Heng of Xinchang seized the magistrate and capitulated.
Because Duan Liao repeatedly was a border trouble, sent general Song Hui to declare vassalage to Shi Jilong, requesting troops to strike Liao.
Troubled by Duan Liao, he sent Song Hui to submit to Shi Hu and beg for an allied expedition.
After a fortnight’s siege his officers begged him to yield.

repeatedUseConclusion: All source occurrences of the current Juqiu, Song Hui and fortnight wording are in s0031,s0060,s0065 and covered by this batch. Canonical/staged Juqiu alias and event occurrences are covered by the earlier proposal.
